title: Reported Speech Basics

vocab.ex: She made a statement about the delay.
Backshift moves "is" to "was" in reported speech.
In direct speech, she said, "I am tired."
In indirect speech, she said she was tired.
The article included a quotation from the manager.
He said that the meeting was cancelled.
She told me that she was moving to Brazil.
He mentioned that the report was ready.
She explained that the flight had been delayed.
He claimed that he had finished the project.
She admitted that she had made a mistake.
He promised that he would call back.
She denied that she had seen the email.
The news reported that sales had increased.
According to him, the deal was closed.
Apparently, she had already left the company.
He allegedly said the project would fail.
The source said the news was true.
He admitted that he was wrong.
"Today" becomes "that day" in reported speech.
She said she had called the day before.
He said he would call the next day.
She said the meeting was there, not here.
He said that project, not this one.
She said it happened two days before.
He said he was busy then.
She said she was tired that day.
Can you quote what she actually said?
I will paraphrase what he told me.
He left a message saying he would be late.

expressions.example: She said that the meeting had been rescheduled.

sentences: She said that she was tired.

grammar.title: Reported Speech: como relatar o que alguém disse
rules: Verbos geralmente "voltam" um tempo verbal (backshift): "I am tired" → She said she was tired.
Present Simple → Past Simple / Present Perfect → Past Perfect / Will → Would.
Pronomes e expressões de tempo/lugar mudam: I→she, today→that day, here→there.
Não é sempre obrigatório mudar o tempo, se a informação ainda é verdadeira no presente.

quiz.q: "I am tired," she said. → She said she ___ tired.
"I will call you." → He said he ___ call me.
"I have finished." → She said she ___ finished.
She said that she ___ tired that day.

speak: She said that she was tired.
He told me that he had finished the report.

According to my manager, the deal is closed.
